sloka: न यास्यथः श्रमं वत्सौ भक्षयित्वा फलानि वै ।मूलानि च सुमृष्टानि नगराद्बहिरास्यथः ।। ७.९३.९ ॥
transliteration: na yāsyathaḥ śramaṁ vatsau bhakṣayitvā phalāni vai ।mūlāni ca sumṛṣṭāni nagarādbahirāsyathaḥ ।। 7.93.9 ॥

translations.english: O dear children, you two will not experience fatigue by eating fruits and pure roots, and you will stay outside the city.
